entries.carrier: Zurich (via BFL Canada online cyber platform)
entries.title: Zurich Cyber Insurance Policy Declarations (Cyber Policy Wording)
entries.notes: English. Demo/sample certificate hosted on the BFL Canada cyber quoting dev site (devcyber.bflcanada.ca). The file is named 'Cyber Policy Wording' and its search title is 'Zurich Cyber Insurance Policy Declarations', so it likely has the declarations and the policy wording together. The SMB target is inferred from the broker's online quote platform. Edition not verified.

entries.title: Zurich Canada Cyber Insurance Policy brochure (English)
entries.notes: English. Coverage brochure listing security/privacy liability, regulatory, PCI, media, breach costs, BI/dependent BI, extortion, digital asset and reputational loss. Aimed at mid-sized and large corporates. An older copy of the same brochure also exists at a legacy path: https://www.zurichcanada.com/_/media/dbe/canada/docs/english/security_privacy/cyber-insurance-policy-brochure_canada_final_english.pdf?la=en-ca&hash=F89603F0AB74B6E63017C2BDE7FCF665F2EC6EAB
